current_evidence_response: The protocol groups 51 tasks, uses four-domain LOBO, preserves per-domain results, and applies task-cluster bootstrap.
remaining_weakness: Small data and four domains limit precision and external validity.
needs_new_experiment: no; disclose limitation and use confirmatory test only after freeze

reviewer_challenge: Side Effect has only 12 positives, so its conclusion is unreliable.
current_evidence_response: Agreed for strong claims: all Side Effect evidence is diagnostic/descriptive and the final role is exploratory-only.
remaining_weakness: No current statistic can create missing positive support.
needs_new_experiment: no; lower paper role rather than extend dev indefinitely

reviewer_challenge: Looping features leak the label definition.
current_evidence_response: No-repetition ablation stays strong, while P6 shows a stable but limited repetition increment; full dependence is rejected.
remaining_weakness: Repetition remains construct-adjacent and cannot be treated as a causal mechanism.

reviewer_challenge: LOMO is not true OOD because the same tasks appear in training.
current_evidence_response: Correct; A1.4 is explicitly model-only with 100% task counterparts and supports only conditional cross-model transfer.

reviewer_challenge: Why not use a larger LLM Judge?
current_evidence_response: The research question is lightweight, interpretable evidence under Benchmark shift; paid/large Judge methods are outside the preregistered scope.
remaining_weakness: The work does not claim superiority over large LLM Judges.

reviewer_challenge: Why did B4 not stably beat B2?
current_evidence_response: Q2/Q3 show uncertain AP increments and Q3 shows a stable Success macro-F1 drop, so complexity alone is not uniformly beneficial.
remaining_weakness: Only one dense encoder and one pooling design were frozen.
needs_new_experiment: no; this negative result is part of the contribution

reviewer_challenge: Are results only Benchmark/model identity shortcuts?
current_evidence_response: Identity fields are excluded from frozen inputs; Primary LOBO holds out full Benchmark groups; model-literal injection audit is zero.
remaining_weakness: Natural text can still contain domain-specific content and LOMO shares tasks.
needs_new_experiment: no for freeze decision; preserve as limitation

reviewer_challenge: Why compare pooled AP across held-out models?
current_evidence_response: Pooled metrics are secondary; primary cross-model interpretation uses per-model and macro results because probability scales may differ.
remaining_weakness: Cross-model probability calibration is not established.
needs_new_experiment: no; do not elevate pooled AP

current_evidence_response: Test tuning would invalidate confirmatory evidence; configs and thresholds are selected only inside development training folds and must be frozen before test.
remaining_weakness: Final confirmatory performance is not yet known.
needs_new_experiment: no; test remains sealed pending human freeze approval

reviewer_challenge: Chunk pooling may lose information in trajectories up to 160k tokens.
current_evidence_response: A1.7 uses no truncation, deterministic non-overlap chunks, last-EOS pooling, and payload-weighted normalization.
remaining_weakness: Cross-chunk interactions are approximated rather than jointly encoded.
needs_new_experiment: no for the frozen B4 complexity-control interpretation
